notes: *lotus trees* is headed on *lotus*; the ASV never writes *trees* alone for `צֶאֱלִים`, so the noun is the supplied generic under rule 31.
`סֵתֶר` takes a supplied *the* as a construct with no article morpheme in the chain (rule 29); `קָנֶה` and `בִּצָּה` take their own supplied *the* under rule 15.
